title: Replay 60 L-series Java questions on 23 deployment pairs
description: Recompile the public callers and check the full before/after observations for twenty merged changes, including both Arrow allocators and Guava modules, Derby and PostgreSQL 16, a Maven shade goal and Gradle builds with the pinned named-action method.
